chunks: From him, from Abu Jamilah, from 'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the Imams (peace be upon them both), who said:
The obligatory prayer is not valid inside the hollow of the Ka'bah.

key_terms.جَوْفِ الْكَعْبَةِ: Inside the hollow/interior of the Ka'bah

ai.seo_question: Is prayer valid inside the Ka'bah?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies a specific juristic detail regarding the validity of the obligatory prayer (salat al-maktubah) when performed within the interior of the Ka'bah. While the Ka'bah is the primary direction of prayer (qibla), this narration indicates that the act of prostration or standing within its enclosed structure is not considered proper or valid for the main obligatory prayers, distinguishing between the sanctity of the site and the mechanics of the ritual. This ruling is often discussed in Shia fiqh to resolve apparent contradictions regarding the permissibility of praying inside the Ka'bah versus the preferred location for congregational or individual obligatory prayers.
